text:
mira: quick follow-up to the safetensors format RFC. hit a production case where an older quant shard slipped through and later produced NaNs in GEMM. thinking: fast header probe on open + async deep-verify so we fail early and avoid silent corruption. ok?

jon: paste the minimal node log? dtype vs layout?

mira: node log snippet:
[2026-07-08T10:11:02Z] load_shard: ckpt-9-p2.safetensors index ok, header=legacy
[2026-07-08T10:11:02Z] WARN loader: dtype mismatch expected=float16 found=quant8
[2026-07-08T10:11:02Z] RuntimeError: GEMM produced NaN at layer enc-17

sasha: user choice: probe-on-open (extra small parse) or lazy verify at first exec (delayed failures). probe-on-open seems nicer for predictable errors.

dmitri: Hosted/Dedicated default to probe-on-open. Private should be configurable per-deployment.

mira: low-impact API change: WeightSource.open() still returns Reader + metadata map. Add optional string keys: "serializer_id" and "integrity_status" with values "unknown"|"header_ok"|"header_mismatch"|"deep_ok"|"deep_corrupt". callers that ignore metadata are unaffected.

jon: header schema proposal: magic(4b), serializer_id, schema_version, epoch, mini_sig (fast blake2b-64), optional full_checksum_url. mini_sig fast; full checksum authoritative.

sasha: Console will show per-checkpoint integrity badge: green=deep_ok, amber=header_ok/legacy, red=deep_corrupt. for live flips to red create alert + ticket for Dedicated/Private.

ops: ops risk: rejecting shards on open could cause reload storms during rollout. need a rollout toggle + canary sampling and dashboards: weights.header_mismatch.rate, weights.open.latency, weights.deep_corrupt.count.

mira: rollout sketch:
- canary: sample probe on 1-5% of weight opens, emit metrics
- enable header probe for new uploads; legacy checkpoints accepted and marked "legacy" and queued for background verify on access
- after grace period, provide tenant-level policy to block legacy acceptance behind ops toggle

dmitri: runtime behaviour: if integrity_status==header_mismatch -> attempt compatible fallback (float fallback or older-quant handler) and emit weights.fallback.attempt metric; if fallback fails escalate and surface to customer. verifier daemon computes/fetches full checksum and updates metadata via metadata API.

jon: implementation notes: parse only first N bytes on open to extract header; avoid full parse. add unit/integration CI to roundtrip serializer outputs and ensure header+deep verify semantics.

ci-bot: acknowledged. will add serializer-roundtrip CI job: write shard -> header probe -> compute full checksum -> verify deep_ok. hook on serializer repo PRs.

sasha: i'll mock Console badge flows and incident UI.

mira: i'll open a small RFC patch with header schema, WeightSource metadata keys, verifier behaviour, runtime reactions (fallback + metrics), and rollout plan. owners: mira (author), jon (loader), sasha (console), ops (rollout). landing doc today, starting PR next week. tagging @team-eng-ml for visibility :eyes:
